_header: UNAUDITED W36 (Route A residual, successor of W30)

K0_absent.note: the W30-X reduction needs >= 1 absent slice column; m=28 has none at any of the four two-firing vertices

K1_rowsform.note: agreement is REQUIRED where a column is absent; at m=28 it is not implied and is observed to fail

K2_shared.note: the pigeonhole needs the two firing letters at a tuple to share one matrix; this counts how often they do

K3_rank3.note: both vertices at slice rank 3 on every surviving tuple, and both delivering => rank S' = 3 is not necessary for failure at m=28

K4_rowsrank.note: rank ROWS is the object that decides; it takes values <= 2 freely at points where rank S' = 3
